about: Final-week polls against results, Netanyahu-aligned bloc, every election under the 3.25% threshold. 'field' is the mean of the final poll of each firm other than Direct Polls / Shlomo Filber's firms; 'directPolls' is that firm's final poll where it published one in the final week. Source: Wikipedia opinion-polling pages for each election, read 2026-10-23. Bloc definitions follow the tables: 2015 Likud+Jewish Home+Shas+UTJ+Yisrael Beiteinu+Yachad; Apr 2019 the right bloc incl. Kulanu and YB; Sep 2019 and Mar 2020 Likud+Shas+UTJ+Yamina; 2021 Likud+Shas+UTJ+RZ; 2022 Likud+Shas+UTJ+RZ. 'shasError' is Shas's own seat miss (result minus final-week polls) in the same election, from round1/B-list-bias.md; kept for the record: taking the lean net of it was tested in backtest/v2.mjs and rejected (it turns the leave-future-out lean negative and under-predicts the bloc by 3 seats).

thresholdLists.about: Lists shown at 4-5 seats by most final-week polls, and whether they passed.

perListError.about: theMadad, 2022: mean absolute error per list in polls 0-14 days before the vote.

listPriors.about: Vote-share points added to the field mean before the lean, each a class of list the final-week polls have missed in one direction in both halves of 2013-2022 (round1/B-list-bias.md; the direction confirmed independently in round1/C-threshold.md and round1/E-context.md). Shrunk 20-40% toward zero. The common lean stays gross: netting it of the Shas miss scored worse out of sample (backtest/v2.mjs).

withdrawn.about: Lists that left the race after the ballot was set; still on the ballot, their votes are wasted. Dropped from the model, their polled share folded into the fringe.

lists.source: Times of Israel, Oct 19, 2026: Gantz withdraws Blue and White

fringe.about: Share of the valid vote for lists the polls do not report (Noam, Haredi Public, micro-lists) plus the withdrawn list's residual: 0.7-1.5% in 2021-22 outside the polled lists (round1/F-review.md F4).

smallList.about: Final-two-week misses of lists polled near the threshold, 2013-2022: sd about 1.0 point, Gaussian (round1/C-threshold.md 1.1).

arabSwing.about: RMS of the Arab lists' bloc miss in 2020-22, +1.0, -1.7, +2.0 seats: a turnout swing of their own (round1/F-review.md F5, round1/E-context.md 2.2).

windowDays.about: One latest poll per outlet within this many days of the newest; in 2019-22 the latest poll per firm beat every rule that let older polls back in (round1/D-pollsters.md 3).
